name: Plant Sciences PhD
summary: Research PhD in plant sciences with a required faculty mentor; MS normally required before PhD entry.
detailsNote: Official information available; Fall 2027 dates not confirmed. Published February 15 and October 15 are annual undated guidance. Funding depends on resources and satisfactory progress.

publishedDeadlines.label: Fall full consideration
publishedDeadlines.note: Regular fall deadline for admission/funding; applications accepted year-round.

documents: Statement of purpose covering professional goals/scientific interests

applicationFee.note: Official English-department application instructions state the University requires a $50 graduate application fee; confirm current Plant Sciences payment and any waiver directly. No Plant Sciences waiver established.

english.toefl: 4 for graduate iBT/MyBest/Home Edition, as printed without test-date distinction
english.note: Graduate table also lists IELTS Indicator, PTE56, iTEP Academic Plus4.5 and CambridgeB2 First. Native-English citizen of listed country or university degree earned in listed country may exempt. Program may require higher standards; no legacy TOEFL scale inferred.

requirements.note: MS required before PhD except rare cases. Admission only if faculty mentor willing; contact before applying. Central bachelor equivalent/GPA3. International applicants provide certified transcripts/English translations, English evidence, financial support and passport. Program GRE policy not established.

funding.note: TA/RA available as funding allows, often combination teaching/research. PhD assistantship support normally limited three years, exceptions depend on grants/external funding; satisfactory progress required. No universal offer or amount established.
